All cadence rows name delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14` and carry `retrospective: true`.

Recorded evidence, by review:

- **Tranche 0, continue (01a1ed84-e111-7082-9fa8-7fe77ccc9024, reviewed by 01a1cf1e-09dd-7580-99cc-de395f3e86cc).** Authorised by the programme owner (2026-11-17). Baselines: B0 is the accepted definition set (this review); benefit profiles are six, each "not measured" with a method, owner and kata. Benefit status B1 through B6 all `unmeasured`. Open risks: "#97 the live engine proof", "the 43 due-now outputs", "the BCM is unstaffed"; programme rows 0. Decision document `01a1eb18-6752-72ff-9c28-cd4a94217de7` at `https://conveyor.nonagentic.ai/design/docs/output-01a1eb18-6752-72ff-9c28-cd4a94217de7.html`.
- **Tranche 1, continue (01a1ffa9-c06f-7921-9d6b-611d871ce6cc, reviewed by 01a1e8a7-8b23-76a9-9114-aafb95f7a545).** Baselines: management `01a1fba9-308c-7cde-9d00-edb7f483f3af`, governance `01a1fba9-9afd-72e3-b41b-dc4287153c35`, boundary `01a1fba9-d095-757c-91ed-afd21ecfa960`, plus scope baselines for S02 `01a1ff85-faae-7c2e-b897-fe957985ca78`, T1 `01a1ff8a-b4f0-7e6e-9cc7-4231076e1039` and T11 `01a1ff8f-47cb-78cf-9db8-d98d863e7dd0`. Benefit status B1 to B6 all `draft`, each recorded against an unpopulated baseline value. Project acceptance: S02, T1 and T11 manifests all `green` at SHA `d367a4a992ca5338c82466e9d6ef308e62b01ba6`, with the notes "P2 long-job proof landed; issue #2 closes with the lane PR", "no contemporaneous governance record; retrospective reconstruction" and "mechanism and tests claimed; no calibrated C0-C5 threshold row". Risk register rows: `01a1ffa9-032a-7792-98c3-a85aa9bad193`, `01a1ffa9-1b48-7f8b-974a-c8d8e5366922`, `01a1ffa9-3907-7c8d-a6c0-819281d6c050`.
- **Tranche 2, pause (01a2006c-8f71-733d-a562-103c144882ce, reviewed by 01a1e8a7-8b23-76a9-9114-aafb95f7a545).** Authorised by the programme owner's standing delegation 01a1ff1f (U5 extension). Baselines: B0 is the accepted programme definition set; the programme baseline is the three programme baselines recorded at tranche 0; scope baselines for S03 and T2 were taken in this tranche. Benefit status B1 to B6 all `unmeasured`. Conditions: "both manifests green at the closing snapshot", "both projects closed on a conformant review or a real waiver", "one retro lesson per finding". Manifests: S03 `red (5 checks)`, T2 `red (4 checks)`; snapshot SHA `7ff27efd65146630e62d9c235458be789fb68c14`; evidence reviewed 2026-11-21. Decision document `01a2006a-8db7-764e-9b21-fee33e71e815` at `https://conveyor.nonagentic.ai/design/docs/output-01a2006a-8db7-764e-9b21-fee33e71e815.html`. Open risks: "no human accepting owner exists in the tenant for a non-conformant waiver", "branch migrations 0062/0063 unapplied on the live primary", "five open P0 code findings programme-wide", "v1-t2-3, v1-t2-6, v1-t2-5, v1-s03-2 open and owned".
- **Tranche 2, continue (01a20227-ca12-708d-b844-8ad4c08076bb, reviewed by 01a1e8a7-8b23-76a9-9114-aafb95f7a545).** Programme baselines are the same management, governance and boundary records as the tranche 1 review; scope baselines are S03 `01a20063-7af8-727b-b092-24de3821d204` and T2 `01a2005c-5a4f-7eb5-a004-ccb5545eb6fb`. All six benefit profiles are `draft`, each with baseline "not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)" and targets: B1 "every choice has a decision row", B2 "every service a job uses is a toolkit; a toolkit with no calls in a cycle is retired or justified", B3 "one self-development run reaches live verification on evidence; a second is repeatable", B4 "at least one outside contribution changes a published output; every output is reachable", B5 "the T0 gate exists and refuses a second store; the registry has one home", B6 "the seed, coverage and published checklist agree at every tranche review". The risk register notes that no risk is waived except the owner-accepted S14 residual, and lists as open: "the four closure reviews for T14, T16, T3 and T7 are not yet published; they belong to their tranches", "tranches 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 10 await authorisation in sequence after tranche 3", "code P0 v1-s06-2 (S06) remains open; v1-s14-1 is owner-waived with its receipts NOT PROVEN", "the TOGAF artefact record's Links/Document/Entries gaps are being repaired across the 80 approved artefacts", "S06b's external agent app is absent; it remains an environment gap", "the live pack lags the committed pack until the next publish".
